faq.question: What are your hours?
faq.answer: We're open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM. We're closed on Sundays.

faq.question: How much is a service call?
faq.answer: Our diagnostic visit is $89, and we waive it if you go ahead with the repair.

faq.question: What areas do you serve?
faq.answer: We serve Austin and nearby cities, including Round Rock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Leander, Lakeway, Bee Cave, Kyle and Buda.

faq.question: Do you offer a warranty?
faq.answer: Yes. Repairs come with a 1-year parts and labor warranty, and new installations come with a 10-year manufacturer parts warranty plus our 2-year labor warranty.

faq.question: How can I pay?
faq.answer: We accept credit and debit cards, cash, check and Zelle. Financing is available for new installations.

faq.question: How much does a tune-up cost?
faq.answer: An AC tune-up is $129 per system.

faq.question: How much does a new AC cost?
faq.answer: A new AC system usually runs between $4,500 and $9,000 depending on size and efficiency. We start with a free estimate visit, and Haris confirms every install quote personally.

faq.question: How soon can a technician come?
faq.answer: Usually the same day or the next business day, depending on your area and our schedule.

faq.question: Do you offer emergency service?
faq.answer: Yes, for urgent breakdowns we try to get someone out the same day. If you smell gas or see sparks or smoke, leave the house and call 911 first.

faq.question: Which brands do you work on?
faq.answer: We service all major brands, including Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Goodman, Rheem and Daikin.

faq.question: Are you licensed and insured?
faq.answer: Yes, our technicians are licensed in Texas and we're fully insured.

faq.question: Can I cancel or reschedule?
faq.answer: Of course. Please let us know at least 2 hours before your visit so we can reassign the technician.

faq.question: Do you have a maintenance plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Our Comfort Club plan is $15 a month and includes two tune-ups a year, priority scheduling and 15% off repairs.

faq.question: Do you do commercial work?
faq.answer: Yes, we work with offices, stores and restaurants. Haris reviews every commercial job personally.

faq.question: What services do you offer?
faq.answer: AC repair, tune-ups and installation, water heater repair, plumbing repairs, and electrical repairs.
